SPELL_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE )
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then local controller = target:GetPlayer() EffectDC():Set_PlayerPtr(1, controller) end
local card = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if card ~= nil then card:MidResolutionSetController(EffectController()) end
SPELL_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: local card = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if card ~= nil then card:SetController(EffectController()) end
local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then local characteristics = target:GetCurrentCharacteristics() characteristics:Bool_Set(CHARACTERISTIC_HASTE, 1) end
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then target:Untap() end
SPELL_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) local controller = EffectDC():Get_PlayerPtr(1) if target ~= nil and target:GetController() ~= controller then local characteristics = target:GetCurrentCharacteristics() characteristics:AI_SetWorthless() end -- The creature is only made worthless if the controller actually changes. This worth in conjuction with the script that locks in the controller before control changes. -- This was done to stop weird AI issues
